auditChecks.description: Fleet is safe to commit and deploy.

recoveryClasses.label: Refresh stale generated evidence
recoveryClasses.guardrail: Regenerate maturity, health, monitoring, and visual reports.

recoveryClasses.label: Rerun live dashboard check
recoveryClasses.guardrail: Run the live E2E or monitoring check for the affected dashboard.

recoveryClasses.label: Refresh production visual proof
recoveryClasses.guardrail: Capture/compare visual proof and update the visual gate report.

recoveryClasses.label: Restart a stalled collector or worker
recoveryClasses.guardrail: Requires project owner approval and linked evidence of stalled collection.

recoveryClasses.label: Run pruning or compaction
recoveryClasses.guardrail: Requires quiet window, backup proof, dry-run estimate, and rollback plan.

recoveryClasses.label: Enable a controlled mutating action
recoveryClasses.guardrail: Requires command governance approval and action unlock evidence.

recoveryClasses.label: Deploy dashboard change
recoveryClasses.guardrail: Requires ship check, maturity report validation, web build, and production verification.

recoveryClasses.label: Delete or destructively prune data
recoveryClasses.guardrail: Blocked until retention policy, backup proof, owner approval, and restore test are present.

nextActions: Resolve recovery audit check daily-clear: Daily operating view is clear.
